tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos rgyal la brten pa'i zor las gnam lcags thogs 'beb bzhugs/

na moḥbadz+ra bhai ra wa ye/ gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i sprin phung las/ bzod dka'i gnam lcags thog gi zor babs pas/ khams gsum dgra bgegs brag ri skad cig la/ thal bar brlag mdzad bstan srung tshogs rnams rgyal/ /'dir gzhan don byed pa'i don gnyer can 'ga' zhig la phan 'dod kyi bsam pas/ chos rgyal la brten pa gtso bor byas pa'i sgo nas glo bur las bcol gyi zor las byed tshul zhig brjod par bya ste/ 'di la'ang zor nyid lhar bskyed mi bskyed gnyis las mi skyed pa ni 'jug pa bde bas de'i dbang du byas na/ chos rgyal gyi bskang gso gang mang bstod bskul dang bcas pa dang*/ mgon po sogs chos skyong gzhan gyi bskang gso sogs ma grub kyang mi 'gal yang*/ 'grub na byas tshe phan pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur bas der bstun gyis sngon du btang nas/ 'phen gtor chen po'am chung yang rung ste gdong gral gyi mjug tu stegs kyi khar bzhag /chu gnyis nyer spyod rnams dang de'i mdun du drug cu pa dkyus ltar bshams la/ /me ram legs par byas nas chad chu nang mchod rnams rim par bran la mchod gtor rnams thun mong du byin rlabs mdzad par zhu zhes snyan gsan 'bul ba'am/ min yang rung ste/ mchod pa dang gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/ de nas rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ sngon po'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyis phyogs skyong bco lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ zhes pa nas/ spu gu can rnams su gyur/ oṃ ya ma rā dza nas hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa oṃ bhu tsa ra ṇaṃ sogs lan bzhis phyag rgya dang bcas bzhi cha phul/ /spyan 'dren gyi skabs las kyi gshin rje phyogs skyong bco lnga zhes sbyar na'ang legs/ /oṃ da sha di ka sogs kyi mthar chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo rnams dang*/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ btags la nang chod kyang 'bul/ /bcom ldan chos rje sogs kyis 'phrin las bcol/ spro na/ phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la bstan pa dang dgon gnas rnal 'byor ba sbyin bdag 'khor bcas la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad thal bar brlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig

/ces 'dod don de brjod pa thal mo brdeb /slar yang*/ hrīḥṣ+tīs nang mchod gtor zhing mthar yi ge gsum lan gsum brjod de/ gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi pa yang sngar ltar phul/ 'di ni drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor 'bul bsdus pa ste lan re re la'ang zor gyi rnam pa bzhi bzhi ste bcu drug re 'bul zhing*/ de ltar lan bzhi bsdoms pa la drug cu rtsa bzhi 'bul ba 'byung ngo*/ /de nas gtor ro rnams kyang 'phen gtor zur du phyogs gcig tu bzhag /gtor ma sngar thun mong du byin gyis brlabs pa yin na des mthus la/ min na 'phen gtor sger du byin gyis brlabs kyang rung*/ 'bul yul chos rgyal 'khor bcas zur du spyan 'dren pa'am/ sngar spyan drangs nas yod pa rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par dmigs te/ chos kyi rgyal po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags lan bdun nam gsum phul nas/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo nang mchod dang bcas pa 'bul/ spro na ho 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi bka' stod sogs gtor rdzong rgyas pa'am/ chos rgyal yab yum 'khor bcas la/ sogs kyi bsdus pa bya'o/ /de nas gzhi bdag gtor ma yang phul la/ phul zin pa'i rjes su sngar gyi gtor ro rnams dang 'phen gtor nyid zor du sgrub pa ni de la dmigs te/ hrīḥṣ+tīḥs bsangs/ swa bhā wa nas shuṇ+ḍonya haṃ/ zor mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ /stong pa'i ngang las ya yig nag po hūṃ gis mtshan pa de las drag po'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi mthu stobs nus pa srin po drag tu khros pa lta bu'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ ya yig hūṃ gis mtshan pa la thim/ /de yongs su gyur pa las gnam lcags kyi thog zor me rab tu 'bar ba stong gsum gyi dgra bgegs thams cad skad cig gis brlag par byed pa'i nus pa can du gyur/

slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma thams cad dang lha srin sde brgyad thams cad ky-i nus mthu thams cad kyang thog zor gyi rnam par bkug nas gtor zor la thim par gyur ces lan gsum mam gcig drag bsgrub dang bcas pa bya'o/ /de nas zor bskul ni/ hūṃ rnal 'byor bdag gi gtor zor gnyan po 'di/ /rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla mas byin gyis brlabs/ /yi dam lha dang mkha' 'gros nus pa bskyed/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtshos drag por bsgrubs/ khyad par gsod byed las kyi gshin rje khyod/ /cho 'phrul stong gis dgra la ltas ngan thong*/ / 'khor bcas zor chen rdzas kyi mthu bskyed la/ /dgra bgegs 'byung po'i srog la dbang mdzod cig / bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho mthu ma chung*/ /sgrol byed pho nya las mkhan rtsal ma zhan/ /bdag gi gtor zor gnyan po'i mthu bskyed la/ /dgra bgegs 'byung po'i srog la dbang mdzod cig /sdang dgra gnod byed bgegs la 'phen pa'i phyir/ /dam nyams sdig can thal bar brlag pa'i zor/ /dam can sde brgyad dmag dpung bskyed pa'i zor/ /mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad bzlog pa'i zor/ zhes dang*/ hūṃ bla ma yi dam gshin rje gshed po dang*/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /snang srid dregs pa sde brgyad 'khor bcas kyis/ /do nub drags po'i zor gyi las mdzod cig /ces 'phen gtor dgra bgegs 'joms pa'i nus pa mthu chen du song bar bsam mo/ /de nas lam sel gyi gtor ma de/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ/ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ kā ro lan gsum gyis bsngaus pa'i mthar/ yul lha gzhi bdag gnyan po khyod rnams la dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di 'bul lo/ /bzhes shig bzhes nas kyang rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pas do nub drag gtor gyi las byed pa 'di la/ko long dang ru nga phrag dog mi byed par zor sna dgra bgegs 'byung po'i steng du drongs la thal bar rdul phran bzhin du brlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig

/ces bsgo'o/ /de nas 'chi bdag ma sngar ma btang na 'dir rdul du rlog ces pa'i bar gtong zhing zor bsgyur ni/ hūṃ da ni zor bsgyur dgra la bsgyur/ da ni zor 'phen dgra la 'phen/ /da ni zor kha dgra la bsgyur/ /da ni zor kha bgegs la bsgyur/ /zhes zor kha sgo phyogs su bsgyur/ /de nas zhwa gyon nas bzhes te zor lam dbye ba ni/ hūṃ rnal 'byor dbang phyug zor 'phen no/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug zor 'phen pas/ / nyon cig lha srin sde brgyad rnams/ /mtho ba rnams kyi zhabs bsdus shig /dma' ba rnams kyi dbu zhum zhig /thad ka rnams ni sku gzur cig /gal te ma gzur zor phog na/ /ko long phrag dog ma mdzad cig /nyes pa bsdebs su mi 'dzin par/ /zor sna sdang ba'i dgra la drongs/ /zor sna gnod pa'i bgegs la drongs/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug zor 'phen no/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug gtor zor 'di/ /rtse mo rdo rje'i mdung las rno/ /rtsa ba rdo rje'i brag las sra/ /drag shul gnam lcags thogs las che/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug zor= /rnal 'byor dbang phyug= /steng gi lha la mi 'phen no/ / 'og gi klu la= bar gyi btsan la=/ /gzhi bdag rnams la= /rnal 'byor= rnal 'byor= sdang bar byed pa'i dgra la 'phen/ /gnod par byed pa'i bgegs la= /phung bar byed pa'i sri la= /rnal 'byor= rnal 'byor= sgo ba rnams kyis sgo phye zhig /sgo ba rnams kyis sgo phye na/ btsas su gzugs can dgra 'bul lo/ / 'phrang ba rnams kyi 'phang sol zhig /'phrang ba rnams kyi 'phrang bsal na/ / btsas su gzugs mad 'gag pa= bh+yo bh+yo de ni dgra la bh+yo/ /bh+yo bh+yo de ni bgegs la bh+yo/ /chos chos de ni dmag la chos/ /dmag dpung bskyed la nu mtshon 'phyor zhes brjod la sgo'i phyi rol tu thon/ /de nas gtor ma rnams bzhag la/ /gser skyems 'bul ba la gsum gyi dang po 'bul ba pos rang gi rgyab ngos gyi steng nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i bla ma yin dam rnams dang gshin rje gshed kyi lha tshogs dang*/

gnyis pa chos rgyal sogs chos skyong rnams dang*/ gsum pa ni mdun ngos kyi lha klu gzhi bdag sogs la 'bul bar bsams te/ hūṃ bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum/ rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs dang*/ khyad par bcom ldan gshin rje gshed/ /gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes nas/ /bdag gi gzu dang dpang mdzod la/ /dam nyams 'di yi skyabs ma mdzad/ /gshin rje gshed kyi bka' sdod mchog /chos kyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas/ /gzhan yang dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /gser skyems= bdag gi= dam nyams= dbyu gu drug cu rtsa bzhi sogs/ /lo zla zhag dus lha rnams dang*/ /khyad par yul phyogs 'dir gnas pa'i/ /lha klu gzhi bdag 'khor bcas rnams/ /gser skyems= bdag gi= /dam nyams= gzu dang dpang las mtho ba med/ /rnam par dag pa'i thugs kyis gzigs/ / gser skyems mchod pa rgya re che/ /'bru sman sna tshogs rin che bas/ /de ring bdag gi grogs mdzod cig /zhes brjaud cing khams phor ram gtor theb sogs kyi snod nas 'bul te phrin las bcol bas khas blangs par bsam mo/ /de nas chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje'i tshogs/ zhes sogs sam/ /dge sdig shan 'byed ma gang rigs dang*/ 'dod na gnod sbyin bzhi bskul yang*/ btang chog pa'i skabs yod cing*/ /oṃ mi mngon dbyings na bzhugs pa'i rgyal bzhi khrau'i tshogs/ /ā bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs/ / hūṃ bskul lo bskul lo 'gro ba'i don la bskul/ /hrīḥ mdzod cig mdzod cig bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces bskul bas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i zhi khro'i tshogs thams cad khros pa'i rnam par gyur nas rang dang lhan cig 'byon bar bsams la 'cham pa dang ces saṃ min yang rung ste/ gu gul sogs kyis 'dug cing gser skyems dang khrag chang gi phud rnam gtor/ rol mo dang bcas pa rang nyid 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis gtor ma 'phen sar phyin nas gtor ma rnams bsgrigs te/

/grogs rnams kyis sdang dgra ma lta bus bskul ba'am min yang*/ chos sku yangs pa'i sogs kyis zlog pa dal bus brjod/ /de'i ring la slob dpon gyi gtor ma'i rgyab nas sngar gyi gser skyems 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad de dag gam/ bsdu na dang po la/ bdud rtsi'i gser skyems 'di ni rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang rgyud sde bzhi 'brel gyi yi dam lha tshogs rnams la 'bul lo/ /gnyis pa la 'di ni chos kyi rgyal po yab yum la sogs pa'i chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams la 'bul lo/ /gsum pa la/ 'di ni lha klu rnams dang yul lha gzhi bdag gi tshogs thams cad la 'bul lo/ /khyed rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i gser skyems kyi mchodapa 'di bzhes la/ dam nyams 'di'i mgon skyabs ma mdzad par bdag gis gzu dang dpang po mdzod cig /ces 'phrin las bcol/ de nas gzhi bdag gtor ma yang blangs te/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di ni lha klu gza' skar rnams dang sa phyogs 'dir rgyu ba'i gzhi bdag gnas bdag sogs mi ma yin gyi tshogs rnams la 'bul lo/ / gzhes nas ko long phrag dog mi byed par mthun rkyen thams cad sgrub pa'i grogs mdzad du gsol/ zhes bsngo/ de nas liṅka bskyed chog dang dgugs gzhug bsdu na/ rang gi mdun du bsreg khang gru gsum pa'i dbus su 'brub khung nag la gting yangs pa'i nang du bstan pa dang dgon gnas rnal 'byor pa sbyin bdag 'khor bcas la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs gcer bu'i gzugs can/ skra bshig cing nyam chung ba/ /'dar had had byed pa yan lag thams cad bcings te mgo 'thur du bltas nas gnas par gyur/ rang gi thug ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa'i sne las khro bo phyag na lcags kyu dang zhags pa dang tho ba thogs pa dpag tu med pa byung ste gang la dmigs pa'i gnod byed kyi dgra bgegs de dag bzung bcings brdeg bzhin par bkug nas liṅga la bcug par gyur/

ces brjod/ rgyas par na bden brjod gyis dgugs gzhug kyang bya'o/ /'di ni cung zad rgyas pa'i lugs yin la/ shin tu bsdu na da ltar bsam pa tsam byas kyang rung ngo*/ /gtor gdugs yod dam med kyang rung la yod na de nyid 'deg pa tsam ma gtogs lha bteg rgyu ni med do/ /de nas/ hūṃ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams/ /sogs kyis bskul ba'am min yang rung ste/ gtor ma phrag gong g.yas su 'phyar te rdor ra'i sgab btegs pa'i phyi rol nas rngam brjid dang ldan pas gtor rtse tshur mi ldog pa'i tshul gyis dgra bgegs dngos gnas su bsam pa de'i steng du 'phangs pas bshang lam nas zhugs te snying ka'i rnam shes mar me ltar yod pa de nyid la phog pas nag thum gyis song bar bsam zhing*/ de dang mnyam du zor chung mang po thog ltar byung nas gnod byed kyi rigs thams cad brlag par bsam mo/ /de nas dgra bgegs kyi rnam shes 'chi ba 'od gsal gyi ngo bor gnas pa de nyid rang gshin rje gshed du gsal ba'i bde stong gi ye shes dang dbyer med du 'dris te/ slar yang gi snying kha nas zur du bye nas bde ba can nam mngon dka' sogs su song bar bsam pa ni de la phan gdags pa'o/ /gsad bya ba sgral ba'i sha rus sogs ni chos skyong 'khor bcas kyis gsol ba'am sprul pa'i bya rgod sogs kyis za zhing khyer ba'am ci rigs su bsam par bya'o/ /de nas zhwa dang gos brdab pa'am/ yang na g.yob dang lan gsum g.yob cing*/ zhal tshur la phyogs te oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ oṃ dz+wa la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa zhes brjod nas rdo rje'i ra ba'i sgab bteg pa slar phab pa'i mos pa bya zhing*/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba gur bla re me ri dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs par gyur par bsams la/ ngag gzhan bcad hrīḥ ṣ+tā ིཿbzla zhing phyi mig me blta bar nang du 'ongs nas srung 'khor rgyas par na/ hūṃ steng yang rdo rje'i gur khang

āḥ/ 'og kyang rdo rje'i sa gzhi ste/ phyogs mtshams rdathra rje'a.a ra bas bskathrarathathardathra rjapya'a.a mtshams las ma 'da' zha.agathar bakha rarja rarja hajathakapyang yang ral gra.a'a.ana'athraganaphyathragasanaral gra.a'a.anar khab rarjanakapyang yang 'khathrar lathra'aṭhana'athraganaphyathragasana'akhathrar lathra'a.anar tsakranakapyang yang mda' ya.ana'athraganaphyathragasanamada' ya.anar pya ranakapyang yang mapya ya.ana'athraganaphyathragasanamapya ya.anar snya la rarja rarja hajaja zhapyas brjathradathadapya nas than pa'a.a dngathras grab ma 'dathran ca.ang mchathrad rdzas bya.an gya.as brlabs nas 'balathamanga' gsathral bya ba na.athahaja 'jams dbyangs bka' khathrad kathrabs chapyan gsha.an rjapya'a.a gtsadrathathakhyathrad na.a dra.an can rtsa brgyad bla ma dang thatharab 'byams rgyad khapya bzha.a dang yathrang 'brapyal ba'a.athathaya.a dam lha tshadrags ngathra bathrar mnga' gsathral lathrathathadran pa tsam gya.as mchathrag dang than mathrang ga.atha'adathrad rga'a.a char 'bapyabs sangs rgyas chathras tshadrags dang thaganas gsam dpa' bathra mkha' 'grathra chathras nyathrang ba'a.athathabakan srang kan gya.a gtsadra bathraranasra.ad gsam nyapyapya 'grathra'aṭha srathrag la dbang btar zha.ang thathadagapya kha.ag shan 'byapyad bkan dgra kan gya.a gshapyadathathabakan 'dzaṭan ba bzha.an nyathrang ba'a.a dam tshaṭag canathatharnal 'byathrar dgra lha chapyan pathraranathakhyad par rgyal ba gnya.as pa gtsadrang kha pa'a.athathabakan dang bkan 'dzaṭan yathran mchathrad ma las pathathab kar brtsapya bas srang zha.ang nyathrang mdzad pathathabakan srathrag dpa' bathra chapyan pathraranathamadathrar na rnal 'byathrar ma.a nathrar dgathran gnas bcasathathalha chapyan chathras kya.a rgyal pathra 'khathrar bcas lathathabacathral lathra bltathras sathra rtag ta gnyapyar mdzadrad lathatha'agal rkyapyan kan sathral mthan rkyapyan ma las phabasathathazhapyas pa dang thasha.as brjathrad kyang bya'athrathathadapya na.a gtathrar ma lhar ma banyapyad pa'a.a lags ya.an lathalhar banyapyad par 'dathrad na gtathrar chapyan gya.a mdan da 'bal gtathrar gra gsam pa sha khrag ga.as brgyan pa bsham dgathras sha.ang thathathrag ma'a.a mchathrad gtathrar bya.an rlabs kya.a rjapyas satha'aphapyan gtathrar hra.a'agya.a'as bsangasathapya dras dngasathathakathrang pa'a.a ngang las ga tshadrags paṇa dang nya.a ma'a.a gdan la ya las thathrad dbyag sathrags banyapyad tshal rgyas bakhas ca.a ra.ags kya.as chathras rgyas 'khathrar bcas sa banyapyad lathayapya shapyas pa than drangs nasathas ma ya laja gya.a bar dang thar ka la ra pa sa pa ra.a wa ra ayaja pra ta.a rgya hajaja pyaha nasathashasla'a.a bar dang thanang mchathrad kyang dbal lathrathathadapya nasatha'ajam dpal bka' nyan ma sathrags kya.as bkathrad dpyathaphyathrags nyathrang than drangs nas drag ca ba dang gtathrar chang chathras rgyal 'khathrar bcas la 'bal ba sathrags sngar bzha.an ya.an yang thaskabs dpyar zathrar banyapyad gzhag nas zathrar btar sathrags byas tapyathagatathrar ma 'phapyan par phya.an pa'a.a tshaphya dgag gzhag ga.a rjapyas sathahaja bakha ad ta.akrathazhapyas pas gtathrar gdags ltag pa'a.a phyathrags sa btapyag pa'a.a tshaphyathachathras rgyal 'khathrar bcas rnams sa dmag dpang ga.a nang da bzhags par bsams lathagatathrar ma zathrar da banyapyad pa sathrags bya'athrathathadapya lta ba'a.a gtathrar las 'da.a na.a dgathran khapya lta ba tha.a.a'a.a dathran da ya.ad nathadagra bgapyags gang la dma.ags kyang byar rang lathadapyar ma zad lcags mthar dang drag pathra'aṭha da.an srapyag sathrags kya.a sgathra nas kyang drag las byapyad pa'ang dpya ltar rathrathathabakan pa dang sapyams can la phan ma.a thathrags pa'a.a gang zag rapya rapya gnya.as rapya tsam gya.a chapyad da rang dgar da dgra la dma.ags pa'a.a drag las ma.a rang yang thagadathran bgapyag la dma.ags pa'a.a drag las na.a gang zag rapya rapya ba gzhan gya.a chapyad da'ang rang ngathra thathada.an srapyag la brtapyan nas drag las cang zad byapyad na drag pathra'aṭha da.an srapyag kabs ma bdapya ba'a.a tshaphya las thams cad pa'a.a da.an srapyag la brtapyan nas bya kapyathadapya yang rjapya'a.a da.an srapyag dngathras grab rgya mtshadra lasathalas thams cad na.a ba'a.a thab na.a rgya dang dbya.abs zha.a ba'a.a thab dang 'dra yang zhapyas sathrags gsangs pa ltarathathadapya la zha.a ba las thams cad pa sathrags bzha.a yathrad kyang bzha.a ka'ang thab kya.a dbya.abs dang rgya dpangs na.a zha.a ba dang 'dra ba latham ran la gapya sar zapya' dang bcas pa dang thakha khyapyar pad 'dab kya.a dbya.angs lta ba dang thanang da rdathrar 'phrapyang ga.as bskathrar ba'a.a pad 'dab brgyad kya.a phyathrags bzha.ar 'khathrar lathra ra.an pathra chapya paṇa ral gra.athag tshadrags rdathra rjapyathadabs sa khrathra bathra'aṭha rdathra rjapya'am rdathra rjapya rtsapya lnga bathakha khyapyar gya.a kapyang ga.a mtshams rnams sa ga tshadrags rdathra rjapya dang rdathra rjapya rtsapya gsam pa'am ral gra.a 'bra.a'athrathathathab dang lha'a.a kha dathrag na.a las bzha.a gang byapyad pa dpya'a.a mdathrag dang bkan nas sathrathathayang dngathras grab rgya mtshadra lasatha'athrad snyapyar thabs kya.as bzha.a dang bad sha.ang dang mapya'a.a skabs sa las thams cad pa la las sathra sathra dang rjapyas sa mthan par bya bar gsangs pa tsam lasathalas bzha.a ka 'athrad ma.a 'athrang ma.a gsal yang bzha.a ga yathrad pa ya.an tapyathazhapyas gsangs nas rdathra rjapya 'phrapyang ba'a.a lang drangs pa ltar nathadrag pathra las thams cad pa'a.a thab ta ma zadathazha.a ba las thams cad pa'a.a thab ta yang drag las byar rang bar mngathran tapya brtag gathrathada.an srapyag thams cad la yam sha.ang dang mar kha ngapyas par dgathras kyang thardzas gzhan rnams tshang dgathras pa'a.a ngapyas pa mapyad par gsangs sha.ang thamar kha zhapyas pas na.a 'bra mar yang khad dathrathathala.atsha baphal bar 'dathrad na zan dang shathrag la.ang gang byapyad skabs dang bkan nas dgag gzhag ngapyal tshaṭag dathrar tshal sathrags
